name: serveros-fleet
description: ServerOS Fleet — reach an authorized Linux device and its Claude/Codex sessions through the Fleet ingress MCP server. Carries a remote streamable-HTTP MCP binding and the operator Skills that teach an assistant to discover a real device, reuse an idle session before creating one, and accept only evidence it actually read.

interface.shortDescription: Reach an authorized ServerOS device and its Claude/Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Discover the enrolled devices and the Linux accounts behind them, reuse a session that already holds the context, create one only inside an owner-approved project and runtime, and accept a delegated result only from evidence that was read back.
